scope: Chromium with mock DSH DOM and official token/module contracts; not a real DSH desktop installation

results.name: Theme-only: no video, no input shield, no startup focus change
Startup-only: preserves native light UI, palette, body attributes and focus
Light host: portaled modal, file/code cards, inputs and semantic colors pass AA
Dark host: portaled modal, file/code cards, inputs and semantic colors pass AA
Dialogs added after mounting are themed and stay functional
Both mount orders coexist; disabling startup keeps the theme mounted
Disabling/re-enabling the theme does not pause, restart or dismiss the movie
Theme asset failure cannot delay an independent startup component
Independent DSH apply/effect lifecycle and repeated enable/disable leave no owned DOM
Published packages contain distinct metadata, manifest and only their own media
Configuration overrides cannot re-couple the two components
Brand contrast, fixed native toggle and unclipped knot remain correct
No uncaught browser errors in independent component cases
